name: cloud-dense-context-v0
scope: Exploratory one-seed random-initialized 70M pure GPTNeoX; 2K single-article windows; dense context sensitivity control, not a new method or Qwen hybrid reproduction.
rationale: Failed uniform-probe and sampled-head-normalizer candidates are closed. Measure whether a joint-training cold-start problem actually appears before designing further methods. Native training and warmup already have prior work.
